battle.name: 隋與高句麗的戰爭
battle.brief: 隋文帝開皇十八年正月下詔討高句麗，二月以晉王楊廣為行軍元帥，率數十萬眾自幽州沿遼東走廊東進，十月渡鴨綠水，十二月在清川遭伏大敗，士卒死者十四五，全軍退回。卡面斯巴達長矛屬希臘方陣兵器，與本役相隔一千四百餘年，不在此役現場；隋軍近身用槊與方盾，高句麗則以長弓、騎射與坑道守城。

kit.name: 斯巴達長矛
kit.history: 兩米長的木槍，槍尾帶銅套。方陣裡它比劍更早決定誰站得住。

countries: 這場戰爭是隋朝與高句麗在東北亞邊界上的一場大規模軍事對撞，發生在隋文帝開皇十八年（598）。隋方由中樞直接統兵：文帝以晉王楊廣為行軍元帥，宇文述為主力統帥，于仲文、麥利孝分領諸路，兵馬自幽州出發，沿遼東走廊東下；出師之眾《資治通鑑》記為「五十餘萬」，是隋朝傾國而出的態勢，也是後世「百萬大軍」說法的來源；同一部通鑑另有「甲士百十三萬五千餘人，饋運者倍之」的高數，但該組數字多被繫於大業年間再征之役，與開皇十八年出師之眾未必同源，各家記載自數十萬至百餘萬不等，本來就有出入。高句麗一方以國王高建武為名，實權集中在大莫夫榮寶手中，其弟樸市與之有隙；大將奭信領兵十五萬北上增援，各城邑的城主與部將分兵把守，首都平壤的城防則由大莫夫直接經營。隋軍在東北亞並非孤軍作戰，北方同時受突厥牽制，而高句麗背後則與渤海、靺鞨等東北部族有往來。雙方的支援條件與補給方式，決定了這場戰爭能夠拉鋸多久。
countriesEn: This war was a large-scale military collision between the Sui dynasty and the kingdom of Goguryeo on the frontier of Northeast Asia, fought in the eighteenth year of the Kaihuang era (598). The Sui side mustered the army directly from the centre: Emperor Wen appointed the Prince of Jin, Yang Guang, as commander-in-chief, with Yuwen Shu commanding the main body and Yu Zhongwen and Mai Lixiao leading separate columns; the troops set out from Youzhou (modern Beijing) and moved down the Liaodong corridor. The Zizhi Tongjian records the expedition as 'more than five hundred thousand men', which records the all-out commitment of the Sui state and is the origin of the later talk of a 'million-strong army'; the same work elsewhere gives the high figure of 'one million one hundred and thirty-five thousand armed soldiers, with the supply train twice that number', but that figure is generally attached to the later campaigns of the Daye era and need not be the strength that marched out in the eighteenth year of Kaihuang, the sources differing between several hundred thousand and over a million. On the Goguryeo side the king, Gao Jianwu, held nominal command while real power sat with the Great Moefu, the supreme military commander, Rongbao, whose younger brother Pushi was on bad terms with him; the general Xiesin led fifteen tens of thousands of men north to reinforce the front, town commanders and generals held the provincial cities, and the defence of the capital Pyongyang was run directly by the Great Moefu. The Sui army was not fighting alone in Northeast Asia: the north was at the same time tied down by the Turks, while Goguryeo maintained connections with the Balhae and Mohe peoples of the north-east. The support each side could draw on and the way each supplied itself therefore determined how long the contest could be drawn out.
people: 真正決定開戰的是隋文帝楊堅。開皇十七年，他派諸王出使高句麗，打算以新王朝的威勢懾服對方；高句麗不奉詔令，反而請求從此斷絕兩國往來與邊市，隋廷的回應是怒火。開皇十八年正月，文帝下詔討之，二月發兵，指名楊廣為行軍元帥，等於把幾十萬人的國家信用壓在一次遠征上。楊廣隨軍至遼東，戰局卻從不由元帥決定：真正在前線承擔的是左衛大將軍宇文述，他領主力渡鴨綠水、追擊至清川，陷入高句麗的伏擊與久雨，士卒疲病，軍心崩解，敗退回師；事後文帝追究，宇文述等一度被免官。右衛大將軍于仲文在東路以輕騎襲破高句麗的邊城與柵寨；驃騎將軍麥利孝則率步騎八千在津水逆戰奭信所領十五萬大軍，一戰而破，斬獲甚眾，是本役隋軍為數不多的確切勝利。高句麗方面，國王高建武坐鎮平壤，大莫夫榮寶掌握軍政，榮寶之弟樸市約在開皇十九年前後降隋，洩露高句麗的兵力配置與糧道內情；大將奭信兵敗之後，高句麗仍以城郭與地形為盾，一再挫敗隋軍的攻勢。
peopleEn: The man who really decided on the war was Emperor Wen of Sui, Yang Jian. In the seventeenth year of Kaihuang he sent the princes of the imperial house as envoys to Goguryeo, expecting the new dynasty's weight to overawe them; Goguryeo did not obey the summons and instead asked that all intercourse and border trade between the two states be broken off, and the Sui court's answer was fury. In the first month of the eighteenth year Wen issued the order to punish Goguryeo, marched the army out in the second month, and named Yang Guang commander-in-chief, which amounted to staking the credit of a state and tens of thousands of lives on a single distant campaign. Yang Guang went as far as Liaodong, but the course of the battle was never his to decide: the man who carried the burden at the front was Yuwen Shu, general of the Left Guard, who led the main body across the Yalu River, pursued the enemy to Cheongcheon, ran into a Goguryeo ambush in the long rain, saw his troops fall sick and the heart of the army break, and withdrew in defeat; afterwards Emperor Wen held the responsible officers to account and Yuwen Shu was for a time stripped of his office. General of the Right Guard Yu Zhongwen rode with light cavalry in the eastern sector and broke the border towns and stockades of Goguryeo; General of the Light Horse Mai Lixiao, with eight thousand foot and horse, met Xiesin's host of a hundred and fifty thousand at the Jin River, broke it in a single action and took a great many prisoners and heads, one of the few outright Sui successes of the campaign. On the Goguryeo side the king Gao Jianwu sat at Pyongyang while the Great Moefu Rongbao directed the war; Rongbao's younger brother Pushi, who had been on bad terms with him, came over to the Sui around the nineteenth year of Kaihuang and disclosed the disposition of Goguryeo's forces and the state of its supply lines. After Xiesin's defeat Goguryeo continued to use its walls and its terrain as a shield, breaking Sui attacks again and again.
kits: 卡面這件斯巴達長矛是公元前五世紀希臘重裝步兵方陣的兵器：兩米長的木杆，前端裝矛頭，槍尾有銅套，方陣中雙手持矛自盾後齊進，槍尾的銅套可以插地支撐，也能在接戰時抵住對面的盾。它距開皇十八年已有一千四百餘年，絕不可能出現在鴨綠水畔；598年東北亞戰場上真正交手的長兵器是另外兩套東西。隋軍的骨幹是槊與矛：槊是長柄大刃，步騎皆備，適合對付高句麗的輕甲騎兵；長矛為步兵常備，配合方盾結陣。遠程火力以弓弩為主，排弩與蹶張弩用於壓制城頭，弓箭覆蓋隊形正面。防護靠鍪與札甲，騎兵另有馬具，運糧靠數千輛糧車與大批役夫，車馬的消耗往往比戰鬥更傷元氣。高句麗的裝備特點是弓：長弓大矢，射程遠而箭鏃密；步騎用皮甲與札甲，近身用短矛與長刀，騎兵乘本國良馬，善於馳射與迂迴。守城一方倚靠木柵、拒馬、壕溝、坑道（地道）和平壤的土石城郭；攻城一方則要用巢車、雲梯、飛樓與撞車。雙方的差距正落在這些器械上：隋軍的攻城手段不足，糧道又長，攻守之形從一開始就不對等。
kitsEn: The Dory on the card is a weapon of the Greek hoplite phalanx of the fifth century BC: a two-metre wooden shaft with a head at the front and a bronze butt-spike, carried two-handed behind the shield in the close-order ranks, the spike allowing the shaft to be planted in the ground for support and letting the soldier bear up against an opposing shield. It stands more than fourteen hundred years before the eighteenth year of Kaihuang and could not possibly have appeared on the Yalu; the long weapons that actually met on the Northeast Asian field in 598 were two entirely different sets of things. The backbone of the Sui army was the shao and the spear: the shao was a long-handled blade carried by both foot and horse, well suited to Goguryeo's lightly armoured cavalry, while the long spear was the infantryman's constant companion and was used with rectangular shields formed into a line. Long-range fire rested on bows and crossbows, ranks of crossbows and the powerful drawn crossbow used to cover the walls, with arrows falling over the face of the formation. Protection came from helmets and lamellar armour, the cavalry had their own harness, and the grain moved on several thousand supply carts and a great many drovers, the carts and beasts usually costing more than the fighting did. The hallmark of Goguryeo's equipment was the bow: a long bow throwing heavy arrows, with long range and a dense fall of heads. Their foot and horse used leather and lamellar armour, with short spears and sabres at close quarters, and their riders mounted horses of their own country, skilled at the gallop and at shooting from the saddle. The defenders relied on stockades, cheval-de-frise, ditches, tunnels dug under the ground, and the earthen and stone walls of Pyongyang; the attackers, for their part, had to bring ladder-towers, scaling ladders, flèches and battering rams. The disparity lay precisely in these machines: the Sui had too few siege engines and far too long a supply line, and the balance of attack and defence was unequal from the start.
tactics: 隋軍採多路齊進、逐城攻拔的戰法：主力由幽州出柳城、襄平（遼陽）向鴨綠水推進，沿途必須先掃清高句麗的邊城與據點，前進速度因此被拖慢；更關鍵的是糧道，河北轉來的糧車要走數千里，沿途遭高句麗輕騎游擊與燒毀，隋軍每到一處都要分兵警戒道路，縱隊拉得極長，顧此失彼。唯一利於隋軍的戰機出現在津水：麥利孝以少量精騎逆擊奭信十五萬援軍，與高句麗人在水際纏鬥，趁其陣形未整時擊潰中軍，斬獲甚眾；主力乘勝追擊，越過鴨綠水直抵清川（今清川江，鴨綠江支流），高句麗伏兵四起，又遇久雨，糧道被斷，營中疫癘流行，士卒飢疲，軍隊在清川崩潰，宇文述收攏各軍退卻，渡鴨綠水時已不成軍形。高句麗的戰術是一整套守勢作為：不求野戰決勝，只求據險、斷糧、拖延，把隋軍拖入冬季；鴨綠水與清川的地形、長弓的射程、坑道與柵寨，都被用來消耗遠征軍的銳氣與糧秣。兩相比較，隋軍是攻方的強弩壓制配合重裝步騎，卻缺少對付高句麗山城與坑道的攻城手段；高句麗幾乎沒有主動反攻，全部勝利都來自讓隋軍自己耗盡。
tacticsEn: The Sui method was advance in several columns and the taking of one town after another: the main body left Youzhou, passed Liucheng and Xiangping (modern Liaoyang) and pushed toward the Yalu River, and on the way it had to clear the border cities and strongholds of Goguryeo, so the pace of advance was slow. The supply line mattered even more: the grain carts from Hebei had to travel a thousand li and more, and along the road they were raided and burnt by Goguryeo light horse, so the Sui had to detach troops to guard the road at every stop; the column was stretched out to enormous length and could never be kept all in hand. The one opening that favoured the Sui came at the Jin River: Mai Lixiao turned his small body of picked cavalry against Xiesin's relief army of a hundred and fifty thousand, grappled with the Goguryeo men along the water, struck the centre while their formation was still disordered and took a great many prisoners and heads. The main body followed the victory, crossed the Yalu and drove as far as Cheongcheon, on the modern Cheongcheon River, a tributary of the Yalu; there the Goguryeo ambushed them from every side, the long rain continued, the supply line was cut, sickness ran through the camps, the men were hungry and exhausted, and the army came apart at Cheongcheon. Yuwen Shu gathered the various columns and withdrew, and by the time they recrossed the Yalu they no longer formed an army. The Goguryeo method was a complete defensive performance: they sought no decision in the open field, only a position on the ground, a cut supply line and delay, dragging the Sui into the winter. The terrain of the Yalu and the Cheongcheon, the range of the long bow, the tunnels and the stockades were all used to wear down the sharpness and the rations of the expeditionary army. Set side by side, the Sui brought the massed fire of crossbows and heavy infantry and cavalry against the attacking side, but lacked the siege means to handle Goguryeo's hill cities and underground passages; Goguryeo scarcely counterattacked at all, and every one of its successes came from letting the Sui army exhaust itself.
data: 可查的數字大致如下。出師之眾《資治通鑑》記為「五十餘萬」；另有一組「甲士百十三萬五千餘人，饋運者倍之」的高數，通鑑系多繫於大業年間再征之役（大業十年即 614），而《隋書·煬帝紀》記大業八年（612）出師「總一百一十三萬三千八百，號二百萬，其餽運者倍之」——百萬之數在隋征高句麗的記載中反覆出現，但三組數字分屬不同戰役，唔可以互相套用。對面高句麗的援軍有明確記錄：奭信領兵十五萬；隋軍麥利孝所部為步騎八千，以八千對十五萬而取勝。清川之敗，《資治通鑑》記隋軍「死者萬餘」；全軍退回之後，又記此次出師「士卒死者十四五」，即戰歿與病亡合計約當全軍四成至五成，並有「府庫為空」之嘆。時間上，開皇十八年正月下詔、二月發兵，秋末抵達鴨綠水，十二月兵敗退卻，次年開皇十九年高句麗遣使請和、隋廷罷兵。行程上，自幽州至鴨綠水直線約一千六百里（八百餘公里），道路迂迴，實際里程當在兩千至三千里之間，糧道自河北轉輸，里程更遠。城數方面，傳世史籍沒有留下本役攻克城邑的完整清單，只留下「至清川」「追奔至平壤」一類的行程記載，具體克城數目難以核實。
dataEn: The figures that can be given on good authority are roughly these. The strength of the expedition is recorded in the Zizhi Tongjian as 'more than five hundred thousand men'; a separate high figure, 'one million one hundred and thirty-five thousand armed soldiers, with the supply train twice that number', is generally attached in the Tongjian to the later campaigns of the Daye era (the tenth year of Daye, 614), while the Sui Shu annals of Emperor Yang record the campaign of the eighth year of Daye (612) as 'one hundred and thirteen thousand three hundred and eight in all, called two hundred thousand, with the supply train twice that number'. The figure of a million therefore recurs throughout the Sui records of the wars against Goguryeo, but the three sets of numbers belong to different campaigns and must not be used for one another. The Goguryeo relief force is recorded exactly: Xiesin brought a hundred and fifty thousand men; the Sui force that defeated him under Mai Lixiao was eight thousand foot and horse, and won with eight against a hundred and fifty. The defeat at Cheongcheon is recorded in the Tongjian as leaving 'more than ten thousand dead' among the Sui; after the army returned, the same work records that in this campaign 'four or five in ten of the soldiers died', that is, the killed in action together with the dead of disease came to something between forty and fifty per cent of the army, and it speaks of the treasury being emptied. As to the calendar: the order was issued in the first month of the eighteenth year of Kaihuang, the army marched in the second, reached the Yalu River at the turn of autumn, was beaten back in the twelfth month, and in the following year, the nineteenth of Kaihuang, Goguryeo sent an envoy to sue for peace and the Sui court called off the war. As to distance, the straight line from Youzhou to the Yalu is about sixteen hundred li (a little over eight hundred kilometres), and the actual road was circuitous, so the real mileage ran to between two and three thousand li, with the supply line from Hebei considerably longer. As to the number of towns taken, the transmitted histories preserve no complete list of the places captured; they give only the kind of marching note that the army 'reached Cheongcheon' and 'pursued as far as Pyongyang', and the exact number of cities reduced cannot be verified.
cause: 開戰的直接理由是外交破裂。開皇十七年，隋文帝以新王朝的威勢派遣諸王出使高句麗，詔令高句麗王入朝；高句麗不奉詔，反而請求從此斷絕兩國商貿往來，邊市為之禁止，隋廷無法接受一個新王朝的藩屬用這種方式拒絕冊封，於是開皇十八年正月下詔討之，文帝並把此役說成是對高句麗「拒絕事大」的懲罰。更深一層的背景是開皇年間的整體邊局：隋朝在開皇九年滅陳之後統一了中國，北方的主要威脅換成了突厥；高句麗據有遼東山地與鴨綠水天險，控扼從幽州通往東北的交通，隋朝通往渤海、靺鞨、室韋的使節與物資都要經過其地，隋廷不能容忍這道關口握在別人手中。此外，東北方向的流亡人口問題也曾成為爭端，高句麗收容逃戶，隋朝則指責其庇護，雙方互不信任。開皇十八年，一場原本可以靠封賞、互市與交還流民解決的邊疆糾葛，終於變成數十萬人馬的軍事行動，而隋文帝急於在有生之年清理北方邊患的 心態，也讓這場遠征從一開始就帶上了不容失敗的重量。
causeEn: The immediate reason for the war was a rupture in diplomacy. In the seventeenth year of Kaihuang Emperor Wen sent the imperial princes as envoys to Goguryeo in the manner of a new dynasty, with the summons that the king should come to court; Goguryeo did not obey, and instead asked that all commercial intercourse between the two states be broken off, the border markets being closed. The Sui court could not accept that a feudatory of the new dynasty should refuse investiture in that manner, so in the first month of the eighteenth year of Kaihuang the order to punish was issued, and the emperor described the campaign as a chastisement for Goguryeo's refusal to accept the greater power. The deeper background is the frontier situation of the Kaihuang years. After the Sui had destroyed the Chen in the ninth year of Kaihuang and unified China, the main northern threat had become the Turks. Goguryeo held the mountains of Liaodong and the natural barrier of the Yalu River and controlled the road running northeast from Youzhou; Sui envoys and goods bound for the Balhae, the Mohe and the Xianbei had to pass through its territory, and the court could not tolerate that strategic gateway being held by someone else. The question of runaways in the north-east had also become a point of friction, Goguryeo giving shelter to those who fled and the Sui accusing it of harbouring them, and neither side trusted the other. In the eighteenth year of Kaihuang a frontier quarrel that might have been settled by investiture, by trade and by handing back those who had fled turned at last into a military operation involving tens of thousands of men, and Emperor Wen's wish to clear the northern frontier while he still lived gave the expedition from the outset a weight it could not bear.
impact: 這場敗仗對隋朝的傷害，遠超過一場邊境挫折的分量。物質上，府庫耗空，河北各州為了轉輸糧草而疲於供億，役夫與民戶的負擔被拉長；精神上，隋文帝在敗訊傳回後自責，下令停止進一步的攻勢，轉而遣使責問高句麗，開皇十九年高句麗遣使謝罪，兩國恢復往來。制度上更重要的後果是兵制的轉向：為了再次打高句麗，隋朝把徵發範圍擴及全國丁口，兵源由府兵與宿衛擴大到各州郡的臨時徵發，糧秣與徭役的攤派也隨之加重。到了隋煬帝大業年間，這套在開皇十八年已被證明行不通的用兵方式被放大到極致：大業八年、十三年、十四年三次大舉征高句麗，每次出動的兵員與糧輜都遠超本次，國力被抽乾，反抗隨之而來，隋朝在618年崩潰。反過來看，高句麗贏得了寶貴的喘息之機：它在平壤與鴨綠水一線加強城防，內部則由國王清除大莫夫榮寶的權勢、整合軍政，雖然隨即面對隋朝更凶猛的報復，但王朝本身延續了下來，直到668年才為唐軍所滅。這場戰爭同時也標誌著東北亞戰術格局的一次交接：漢至隋的北方騎兵戰法在此之後逐漸讓位於更重步兵與攻城器械的體系。
impactEn: The defeat did the Sui far more harm than a mere border reverse. In material terms the treasury was emptied and the commanderies of Hebei, worn down by hauling grain, saw the burden of service and supply extended; in moral terms Emperor Wen blamed himself when the news arrived, halted the offensive, and turned to reprimanding Goguryeo by envoys, and in the nineteenth year of Kaihuang Goguryeo sent an envoy to sue for peace and relations were restored. The more important institutional consequence lay in the turning of the military system: to strike at Goguryeo a second time, the Sui widened the levy to the registered population of the whole realm, drawing troops not only from the fubing and the palace guards but from the temporary levies of every commandery, and the apportionment of grain and corvée grew heavier in step. Under the reign of Yangdi of Sui this way of fighting, already shown to be unworkable in the eighteenth year of Kaihuang, was carried to an extreme: the great expeditions of the eighth, thirteenth and fourteenth years of the Daye era each put more men and more transport into the field than this one, the strength of the state was drained, resistance rose in answer, and the Sui collapsed in 618. In the other direction, Goguryeo won a breathing space that was worth much: it strengthened the defences of Pyongyang and the Yalu line, and within the state the king removed the Great Moefu Rongbao's power and reorganised the military command. Though it then faced a far more violent Sui revenge, the kingdom itself survived, and was not destroyed by Tang forces until 668. The war also marks a handover in the tactical pattern of Northeast Asia: the northern cavalry methods of the Han and Sui eras were from that point gradually displaced by a system weighted more towards heavy infantry and siege engines.
result: 就開皇十八年（598）這一季而言，結果是隋軍大敗：平壤沒有攻下，鴨綠水沒有突破，數十萬大軍帶著十之四五的士卒死亡退回國內，府庫為空，隋朝第一次大規模征伐高句麗以最壞的方式收場。直接結果是高句麗保住了鴨綠水與平壤，控制了鴨綠水流域的通道；開皇十九年高句麗遣使入朝謝罪，隋廷罷兵，兩國進入短暫的平靜期。這場失敗並沒有終止隋朝對高句麗的用兵，反而使隋朝把復仇的計畫定得更遠：文帝在位未能再戰，煬帝即位後於大業八年、十三年、十四年三度出師，均告失敗，其中大業八年在清川與薩水的敗績與本次最為相似。以更長的視角看，這場戰爭是隋朝由盛轉衰的一個節點：它證明了遠征東北的攻方無法只靠兵多取勝，也預示了後來三征失敗的結局；而高句麗方面的勝利靠的是城防、弓弩與拖延，並非任何一次野戰的反勝。卡面那件為方陣而生的斯巴達長矛在此其實是一個對照：講究面對面、盾後齊進的希臘式戰法，遇上以騎射、坑道與山城消耗遠征軍的東北亞軍隊，正好說明武器與戰法的真正位置，始終由地理與對手的組織決定。
resultEn: For the campaign of 598 itself the result was an outright Sui defeat: Pyongyang was not taken, the Yalu was not broken, and an army of tens of thousands marched home again with four or five men in ten dead, the treasury empty. The first large Sui campaign against Goguryeo ended in the worst possible way. The immediate consequence was that Goguryeo kept Pyongyang and the Yalu and control of the valley road; in the nineteenth year of Kaihuang Goguryeo sent an embassy to the Sui court to sue for peace, the Sui called off the war, and the two states entered a short period of quiet. The defeat did not end Sui plans against Goguryeo, it made them longer: Wen did not live to try again, and once Yangdi took the throne he campaigned in the eighth, thirteenth and fourteenth years of the Daye era, failing each time, the defeat at Cheongcheon and the Sasu River in the eighth year being the closest parallel to this one. In the longer view the war is a turning point in the Sui's decline: it showed that an attacker campaigning into the north-east could not win on numbers alone, and it foreshadowed the failure of the three later campaigns. Goguryeo's victory, meanwhile, was won through walls, long bows and delay, not through any victory in the open field. The Dory on the card, a weapon born of the phalanx, serves here as a contrast: a Greek way of fighting built for facing the enemy at close range and advancing behind shields, meeting a Northeast Asian army that spent the expedition on cavalry archery, tunnels and hill forts, shows that where weapons and tactics really sit is decided by geography and by how the enemy is organised.
